name: – After recital D – Am 3/1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
part_text: Da. whereas in July 2026 Saudi Arabia struck Sana’a International Airport in violation of the UN-brokered ceasefire of 2022; whereas this action reignited the conflict and led to the current escalation on the Arabian Peninsula and in the Bab al-Mandab Strait; whereas since 2015 Saudi Arabia has imposed a blockade on Yemen’s ports and airports, hindering the importation of food and medicine; whereas the humanitarian situation in Yemen remains among the worst in the world and risks deteriorating further as a result of the renewed hostilities; whereas according to OCHA more than 22 million people in Yemen require humanitarian assistance and protection in 2026, including 5.2 million internally displaced persons;
